nodes.label: /api/categorias complete category list
nodes.rationale: Categories come from PostgreSQL through the API, including categories without books; the inventory form waits for loading and allows retry after failure.

nodes.label: Per-tab sessionStorage identity and token
nodes.rationale: Identity persists across navigation and reloads within the same tab; legacy localStorage identity is discarded.

nodes.label: Guest browsing clears identity and preserves cart
nodes.norm_label: guest browsing clears identity and preserves cart

nodes.label: Stateless JWT bearer authentication
nodes.rationale: Public registration and login issue identity used by authenticated requests; the frontend sends the token in Authorization: Bearer headers.

nodes.label: Backend authorization by token role
nodes.rationale: Inventory and sales history require ADMIN; purchasing requires an authenticated customer or administrator. Frontend role checks control only the interface.

nodes.label: Legacy page URL redirects
nodes.rationale: NavegacionController redirects old page locations, including both /ventas.html and /Ventas.html, while API routes remain unchanged.
